issues.summary: Customer can log in to the storefront with valid credentials
issues.description: As a returning shopper, I want to log in to the e-commerce storefront so that I can access my account, saved addresses, and order history.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a registered customer, when valid email and password are submitted, then the customer is signed in and redirected to the account or home page.
Given the login form, when required fields are empty, then inline validation messages are shown and submission is blocked.
Given incorrect credentials, when the customer attempts to sign in, then a clear authentication error is displayed without exposing sensitive details.
Given a successful login, then the session remains active until the user signs out or the session expires.

testScenarios.name: Successful login with valid credentials
testScenarios.given: A registered customer is on the login page.
testScenarios.when: The customer enters a valid email and password and submits the form.
testScenarios.then: The customer is redirected to the storefront account area and a signed-in state is visible.
playwrightFocus: assert post-login URL or account heading

testScenarios.name: Rejected login with invalid password
testScenarios.given: A registered customer is on the login page.
testScenarios.when: The customer enters a valid email and an invalid password.
testScenarios.then: An authentication error message is shown and the customer remains on the login page.

testScenarios.name: Required field validation
testScenarios.when: The customer submits the form without entering credentials.
testScenarios.then: Required field messages appear for both inputs and no network sign-in succeeds.
playwrightFocus: verify page remains on login form

comments: Use this story as the baseline for Playwright login test generation.
Prefer stable selectors such as data-testid attributes in future automation.
Capture screenshots on failure for login and validation scenarios.
